business_rules.statement: Detection is deterministic and runs on-device, severity classification happens at capture including offline, and the Severity 1 hold is placed locally and immediately.
business_rules.enforcement_point: Frontline Worker Application on-device deterministic layer

business_rules.statement: The platform's audit guarantee is transactional: an action and its audit event commit together, and an action that cannot be audited does not happen.
business_rules.applies_to: every mutating function on every surface, without exception

business_rules.statement: In-app notifications exist as a second channel and cannot be muted.
A notification is never the only mechanism enforcing safety: escalation is delivery, while containment launches locally and the Severity 1 hold is placed on-device without any notification.
Release is Quality Manager only, uniformly, with no exception by work type, risk class or tag.
business_rules.applies_to: lot release including automatic Severity 1 holds

business_rules.statement: The mandatory-role rule requires an approver role to exist whenever a Job exists; but existence is not availability.
The platform audit log is append-only and immutable with no delete or edit path on any surface; tamper-evidence by chained hashes is a V2 hardening.
Nothing is purged; the retention value is a hot-retrievability horizon of 15 years by default, after which data tiers and remains retrievable.
business_rules.enforcement_point: Data Lifecycle and Archival tiering service

business_rules.statement: Retention is uniform across tiers and explicitly not a tier-gated feature, which means it cannot be monetised as an upsell.
The evaluation harness gate is a platform invariant with no off position for any role including the root; an atom or agent whose scenarios are pending or failing cannot be enabled.
business_rules.enforcement_point: Super Admin Eval Harness / Platform Settings

business_rules.statement: No capability exists until a scenario it must satisfy exists; the eval harness is the platform's first engineering artifact.
business_rules.applies_to: every capability on the platform including the on-device deterministic layer

business_rules.statement: Both bands are V1 - the scope is signed as A + B together; the split is an internal build-sequencing lens only and carries no commercial or acceptance meaning.
business_rules.enforcement_point: scope governance; no acceptance criterion references band membership
business_rules.applies_to: Delivery Operations Hub, Frontline Worker Application, Super Admin console

business_rules.statement: An area is assessed at its most blocked point: a module ninety per cent ready and ten per cent blocked on a decision is blocked.
No matrix cell is blank. Where a relationship does not exist, the cell reads Not applicable with a stated reason.
A contradiction recorded in Chapter 51 is never resolved inside a matrix; the cell names the decision identifier and preserves both readings.
business_rules.applies_to: every matrix cell touching a contradiction

business_rules.statement: When the Functional Specification supersedes a section, the requirement identifier survives and gains a second locator; it is not renumbered.
Every material claim carries exactly one source classification from the closed set; a claim with no classification is a defect, not a style lapse.
Every requirement identifier resolves to exactly one Statement of Work locator, or to an explicit statement that the source is silent.
One shared key per matrix, declared in the first column; permitted keys are REQ-*, SCHED-*, TEST-*, FB-* and DEC-*.
No relationship appears in two matrices; the second place carries a cross-reference rather than a copy.
Escalation is notification, not enforcement: the Severity 1 hold is already in force on-device regardless of whether anyone was reached.
Unacknowledged critical notifications re-notify after 4 hours, tightened to 1 hour in Regulated-Industry mode; acknowledgement from any channel stops it.
Qualification-expiry warnings fire at 14, 7, 1 and 0 days; tenants may warn earlier, never later.
Tenants may be stricter than default, never looser than the floor; an out-of-bound value is rejected at the point of entry with the bound stated and is not stored.
Pre-substitution steps remain attributed to the original worker.
The compliance suspension worker-facing message is fixed: "Operation suspended. Contact your supervisor. Your work has been saved."
Patch versions auto-adopt and are tracked; first-two-digit changes are notified to the Job Owner, who decides adoption. The republish description shows on the first screen of the next execution.
Creator may never approve; segregation of duties is absolute on the Job record.
No submission passes with the same person as Author and Reviewer, and the Release Authority cannot be bypassed.
Nothing is machine-translated at runtime, anywhere; English and Spanish render from versioned locale files.
There is no worker-facing pace display, ever.

Provenance is a named location - site, line, cell - never a coordinate and never a gate; media never leaves the application and never touches the device gallery; attribution follows the login, never the device.
business_rules.enforcement_point: capture runtime envelope and evidence store

business_rules.statement: Worker personal data anonymises at 24 months for standard tenants, never in Regulated-Industry mode; anonymisation is irreversible and is the platform's one irreversible act.
A device timestamp outside the tenant's threshold is not trusted to order writes and the event routes to human resolution instead.

Conflict handling is last-write-wins by device timestamp, kept safe by the confirmed clean multi-worker model: work on a shared Run proceeds sequentially with proper hand-over, or is split so each worker owns different steps or different parts.
The in-flight run continues on the version it started with; in-flight runs are never re-based.
A timed-out gate item remains open and human-decidable; it never auto-approves, auto-declines or auto-adjusts.
No scheduled occurrence executes twice for the same due moment; a lease is claimed by exactly one worker process.
No scheduled occurrence commits an effect without its audit entry in the same transaction.
business_rules.enforcement_point: one-transaction audit guarantee applied to schedules

business_rules.statement: Every schedule definition names an owner; none is ownerless.
JBS holds no standing access by default; access is held only under a client grant.
The Frontline application is the only place operational data is created, by workers.
The Read-only Auditor works from the Delivery Operations Hub record, which carries every Command Center decision, and holds no Command Center access at all.
Only in-app and email channels exist at V1; short message service, operating-system push, webhooks, external recipients and quiet hours are outside V1.
A second override in the same area in the same shift escalates to the Quality Manager.
An unacknowledged qualification-expiry notification escalates to the Quality Manager after two minutes.

The Command Center never renders a hold as in force on a device that has not acknowledged it; between the click and the acknowledgement the honest rendering is release issued, propagating, never released.
Support access is reason-required, ticket-linked, time-boxed, tenant-visible and terminable; if the timer fails, the tenant's End-session control still closes it.
Where comprehension and honesty conflict, the honesty gate outranks the comprehension gates and the longer, truer sentence stands.
No completeness claim is made anywhere while an open decision remains.
A walk ends at a TEST-* identifier, at a Not applicable cell with a reason, or at a DEC-* identifier. It never ends at a blank.
Module names are quoted verbatim from the source inventories at 4.1.3, 6.1.6, 7.3 and 8.1 to 8.19, never paraphrased.
Permission cells use only the closed status set; "full access" and "standard permissions" are prohibited phrasings.
Matrix 7 has three mandatory cells per row and none may read "same as online"; offline behaviour is characterised as identical, degraded, deferred or unavailable.
business_rules.enforcement_point: offline gate and triple-cell completeness test

business_rules.statement: Matrix 9 never records an acceptance criterion without a test or a test without an acceptance criterion, because either alone is an orphan.
A function is critical where its failure can harm a worker, break tenant isolation, defeat an authorisation, defeat a qualification or specification control, or lose captured evidence.
No fallback bypasses role-based access control, tenant isolation, qualification, specification, evaluation, approval, publication or the Severity 1 rules.

No agent classifies deviations, releases a Severity 1 hold, self-approves, elevates permissions, changes tenant scope, impersonates a role, bypasses any gate, executes stale queued actions, deletes evidence or audit history, or makes an offline device appear remotely controlled.
No model sits in the deviation-triggering path, so an under-evaluated agent cannot cause a missed deviation.
Publication refuses any capture type not in the engineering item E1 screen-element contract; anything an author can build, the application can render.

Custody of the single Root Super Admin account rests with the client; the account is backend-created at commissioning and is the sole authority for console account creation, role assignment, and every critical-class approval.
Single sign-on supports both Security Assertion Markup Language and OpenID Connect on all tiers, with a platform-managed credential fallback for staff without an identity provider.
Artificial-intelligence compute is bundled with no tenant account or key required.

Enterprise resource planning and manufacturing execution system integration is out of V1 with scaffolding retained: a run source enumeration, reserved fields held null, and a stubbed inbound endpoint returning a not-implemented response.
Where no interim position is safe - the starter taxonomy names being the clearest case - nothing is built and the capability ships empty.
No tenant data is created under a structure that is known to be wrong; where the risk is real, the capability ships disabled.

failures_fallbacks.trigger: a Severity 1 classification at capture
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: the hold is placed locally and immediately without any network exchange
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: escalation delivery waits for connectivity
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: the lot, unit or run stays held until a Quality Manager releases it
failures_fallbacks.recovery: release by the Quality Manager; reconciliation is the propagation-state update per device with lag recorded as telemetry

failures_fallbacks.trigger: a capture cannot be uploaded
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: captures remain committed locally in the encrypted store and queued
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: prolonged disconnection; storage pressure (undefined, see FB-DEVICE-STORAGE)
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: captures queued and unlost; the device blocks no further work
failures_fallbacks.recovery: reconnection and ordered upload; reconciliation is server validation, acceptance and the late-arrival flag

failures_fallbacks.trigger: a command cannot reach the device
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: the command remains queued and is rendered as issued and undelivered
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: the device never returns
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: never rendered as applied; ordering follows the adopted DEC-SYNC-001 class-based split
failures_fallbacks.recovery: device reconnection and ordered application; the acknowledgement writes back the applied state

failures_fallbacks.trigger: a qualification clearance has not reached the device
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: the run parks; the worker continues other assigned runs
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: the clearance never arrives
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: no work proceeds on the gated step
failures_fallbacks.recovery: arrival and application of the clearance command; the Hub record of grant, duration and reason matches the device's applied state

failures_fallbacks.trigger: an escalation is not acknowledged
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: the escalation record stands unacknowledged and visibly marked
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: nobody on shift holds the target role
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: re-notification fires after four hours, one hour in Regulated-Industry mode; nobody-on-shift default contested at DEC-NOSHIFT-001
failures_fallbacks.recovery: acknowledgement from any channel writing the single acknowledgement state; the distinct resolve state is written separately

failures_fallbacks.trigger: a wipe is issued to a device that is offline
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: the wipe command remains pending and the fleet view renders it as pending
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: the device never returns; how long a wipe may remain pending is unstated
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: not rendered as wiped; the device is not assumed erased
failures_fallbacks.recovery: device contact, final-sync attempt, then erasure; contested at DEC-WIPE-001

failures_fallbacks.trigger: device storage exhaustion
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: Not specified in the Statement of Work - explicitly deferred to the Frontline Functional Specification
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: Not specified; no behaviour may be invented here
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: Not specified in the Statement of Work; contested at DEC-STORE-001; no owner named - orphan checks 7 and 8 fail
failures_fallbacks.recovery: owed with the Frontline Functional Specification, engineering register item E6

failures_fallbacks.trigger: emergency pause or agent unavailability
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: in-flight agent runs checkpoint at the next stage boundary and park
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: agents remain unavailable
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: agents render as unavailable, never silence; raised gates stay human-decidable; the deterministic layer continues untouched
failures_fallbacks.recovery: a separate audited resume act; the trace record shows the checkpoint and the resumption

failures_fallbacks.trigger: a new workflow version publishes while a run is in flight
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: the run continues on the version it started with
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: library-pointer interaction is contested at DEC-LIB-001
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: in-flight runs are never re-based
failures_fallbacks.recovery: adoption at the next run boundary or next sync per the tenant's adoption timing; the version number is the audit receipt

failures_fallbacks.trigger: an audit write fails during an action
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: the transaction fails and the user sees the failure
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: none - no partial state is written
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: the action does not happen
failures_fallbacks.recovery: retry of the whole transaction by the user; reconciliation is unnecessary

failures_fallbacks.trigger: an out-of-bound tenant configuration write
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: the write fails at the point of entry with the bound stated and is logged
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: none - the value was never stored
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: the platform never accepts an out-of-bound value
failures_fallbacks.recovery: a corrected write within the bound; reconciliation is unnecessary

failures_fallbacks.trigger: the Command Center board cannot refresh
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: the board renders freshness markers showing data age
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: a stalled refresh reads as a quiet floor
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: the board never implies liveness it does not have; owner declared Not applicable - the surface owns it by construction
failures_fallbacks.recovery: the next successful refresh at the 60-second default or the 30-second per-tenant floor

failures_fallbacks.trigger: a scheduled occurrence misses its due moment
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: the misfire is recorded and the misfire policy applies
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: the misfire policy is undecided at DEC-SCHED-001
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: varies by schedule; digests deliver late and marked late, never silently skipped; nothing is deleted by a missed run
failures_fallbacks.recovery: idempotent re-execution once the misfire policy is decided

failures_fallbacks.trigger: a scheduled occurrence runs twice or fails part-way
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: a lease claimed by exactly one worker process; the second stands down and records as skipped
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: partial failure mid-occurrence
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: a second execution finds the record already finished and does nothing; an already-anonymised identity is not re-processed
failures_fallbacks.recovery: idempotent re-execution of the whole occurrence rather than a partial repair

failures_fallbacks.trigger: risks are recorded once and never reviewed
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: a standing review at every phase gate re-rates each risk against its indicators
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: an indicator that cannot be measured escalates to the programme
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: risks with no working control are named as accepted, with a named accepting role
failures_fallbacks.recovery: new risks added with the same fields; closed risks retained with their closure date rather than deleted

failures_fallbacks.trigger: a dependency is late and the interim position is quietly treated as the final answer
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: the interim position continues with the divergence recorded in the phase report
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: where no interim position is safe, nothing is built and the capability ships empty
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: the platform functions with the dependency absent, degraded honestly and visibly to the affected role; no dependency absence causes silent behaviour
failures_fallbacks.recovery: on arrival the answer is applied through the change-approval cycle; every tenant configured under an interim position is listed for explicit review

failures_fallbacks.trigger: an area assessed as ready with an assumption turns out to have been blocked on a decision
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: stop structural work in the affected area and escalate the underlying decision
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: work already built on the wrong structure is versioned and migrated rather than edited in place
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: no tenant data is created under a structure known to be wrong; the capability ships disabled
failures_fallbacks.recovery: the decision lands, the migration runs, and the phase report records both

failures_fallbacks.trigger: a gate is skipped under schedule pressure
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: the phase proceeds with a named exception listing what was not demonstrated and who accepted it
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: where the undemonstrated item is structural, no exception is available and the phase does not proceed
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: the programme stops at the last passed gate
failures_fallbacks.recovery: the gate is demonstrated and the exception closed; every item built during an exception period is re-verified

failures_fallbacks.trigger: a check is reported as passing on incomplete registers
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: the four-result vocabulary lets an author report partial knowledge without lying or leaving a blank
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: an author choosing Pass with residual where Fail is correct, which no mechanical check can catch
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: the assembly re-run repeats every check against the full document and overrides this chapter's result
failures_fallbacks.recovery: republication of the section with corrected results; the Chapter 55 dashboard must agree exactly

failures_fallbacks.trigger: specification gate evaluated offline
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: limits travel in the version-pinned work package and evaluation is local
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: Not applicable - behaviour is identical offline
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: progression blocked on failure, identically online and offline
failures_fallbacks.recovery: server mirrors the result at sync

failures_fallbacks.trigger: qualification gate posture evaluated while offline
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: enforced from cached credential state within the offline trust window
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: the trust window expires
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: work requiring fresh trust blocks; the run parks
failures_fallbacks.recovery: reconnection refreshes credential trust

failures_fallbacks.trigger: a command is needed while the device is disconnected
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: unavailable until reconnection
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: none - there is no real-time remote control of a worker mid-run, connected or not
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: no surface may imply the device received anything
failures_fallbacks.recovery: ordered application at the next sync

failures_fallbacks.trigger: coaching cards cannot be retrieved
failures_fallbacks.first_fallback: degraded to the authored-instruction fallback carried in the package
failures_fallbacks.fallback_failure: none stated
failures_fallbacks.terminal_safe_state: the authored-instruction fallback always exists, offline included
failures_fallbacks.recovery: retrieval resumes on reconnection

failures_fallbacks.trigger: the training library is opened offline

failures_fallbacks.recovery: reconnection
